notifications.title: renderer/thumbs.py downloads from YouTube, against the no-network rule
notifications.detail: search_refs scrapes YouTube's search page and fetch_thumb downloads thumbnails from i.ytimg.com, both inside renderer/. CLAUDE.md says the renderer never uses the network, and the guard blocks any agent branch that adds such a line there. The code reached main directly, so the guard never checked it. Last night's auditor branch (agent/auditor/2026-11-14, a breakdowns fix) was blocked because its new test in renderer/tests mentioned the download.
notifications.fix: Choose one: 1. Move search_refs, fetch_thumb and refs_sheet into generator/thumb_refs.py (routine-side, where research tools belong) and import them from there; or 2. if the renderer should keep them, say so in CLAUDE.md, so agents know the exception.

notifications.title: One bad setting row resets every setting to its default
notifications.detail: workers/lib/settings.ts validates the merged settings as one object and falls back to the defaults for everything when any row fails (its comment says bad rows are ignored). A row edited by hand in Supabase with a wrong type would quietly switch the uploads pause off and restore the default upload times and daily target in every worker; the dashboard's getSettings does the same. The file is protected, so the auditor can't change it.
notifications.fix: 1. In a Claude Code session: in workers/lib/settings.ts, validate each row with SettingsSchema.shape[key].safeParse(row.value), keep the default only for rows that fail and print a ::warning:: naming the key. 2. Do the same in apps/dashboard/src/lib/store.db.ts getSettings. 3. Add a test with one bad row while uploads are paused.

notifications.title: The hourly watchdog runs only every 4-11 hours
notifications.detail: watchdog.yml is scheduled every hour, but GitHub ran it 11 times between 7 Nov 09:58 and 10 Nov 09:42 UTC (gaps of 4-11 hours). The hourly view snapshots behind the dashboard's 'realtime' chart and the 48-hour views therefore have gaps, and owner alerts can arrive hours late.
notifications.fix: Optional. 1. Accept it, or 2. start watchdog.yml from the Netlify publish heartbeat the way Publish is started (workflows are owner-only files).

notifications.title: The data audit lands after the auditor has run
notifications.detail: The auditor starts around 22:00-23:00 IST, but GitHub starts the 13:53 UTC data-audit cron 3.5 to 5 hours late (17:41 UTC on 17 Nov, 17:21 UTC on 18 Nov, i.e. after 22:50 IST), so tonight's auditor read last night's audit (23 h old) and skipped the data check. The workflow itself succeeds.
notifications.fix: Choose one: 1. move the data-audit cron in .github/workflows/data-audit.yml earlier (e.g. 08:23 UTC) so even a 5-hour delay lands before 22:00 IST; or 2. move the auditor routine to about 01:07 IST (still inside window A).
